blocks.text: Pharmacology is the branch of biology that studies drugs and their effects on living organisms: their sources, properties, composition, therapeutic uses and effects on the body. Drugs are chemical substances used to diagnose, prevent or treat diseases. They may come from natural sources, plants, animals and microorganisms, or be synthesised in laboratories; medicines prepared from plants, used in traditional systems of treatment, are herbal medicines (phytotherapy).

Drug discovery and drug development produce safe and effective medicines. The process begins by identifying the targets that cause a disease and developing compounds that act on them. Before a drug is approved for public use it passes through several stages of testing for safety, efficacy and quality, and scientists, researchers and regulatory authorities work together throughout.
